//: The board copilot's OWN settings layer. Passed as
WHY EMPTY SOURCES, unlike a card:
The copilot is spawned with cwd=daemon/, so until now it inherited whatever
the cwd happened to imply - the operator's personal ~/.claude PLUS the repo's
project layer. Both are wrong here, and the project one is actively harmful:
the repo's Stop hook runs tools/loop_state.py --stop-hook, which BLOCKS a turn
that isn't at a resting build-loop state. That hook exists to stop a coding
agent from resting mid-loop; the board copilot writes no code and has no loop,
so it would be blocked for a build state it can neither cause nor fix.
So: no ambient layer at all, and everything it needs stated here.
The copilot runs --permission-mode plan and executes nothing itself (it emits
an ```actions block the daemon executes), so it is granted no tools here.
The memory Write()/Edit() deny below is belt-and-suspenders for the same reason:
plan mode already withholds the Write/Edit tools, so this only matters if that
mode ever changes - but memory_paths.auto resolves to the SAME shared, non-git
directory for this surface too (measured), so it costs nothing to say twice.
See harness/settings/card.json for the full story.
